03-carnet-aventure:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished redesign proposal for the PROFILE and HISTORY menu of Rabbit Royale, a landscape pixel-art game about rabbits, islands, carrots and raids.
High-resolution 2048 x 1792 visual board: TWO large complete LANDSCAPE interface screens stacked vertically, tiny margins. Title '03 — CARNET D’AVENTURE'. Top small caption 'PROFIL', bottom 'HISTORIQUE'. Each screen an entire interactive game menu shown front on. NO device frame, perspective or hands.
DISTINCT DESIGN: an open ADVENTURER'S FIELD JOURNAL whose two pages ARE the usable interface. Clearly visible narrow central book binding, equal-sized left/right pages. Small labeled colored BOOKMARK TABS attached on the OUTER RIGHT EDGE only: 'Profil', 'Historique', 'Réglages'. Selected bookmark protrudes slightly. NO top tabs, NO left sidebar, NO other navigation. Close small X at top right. Minimal ivory paper texture, moss green #697B4B leather book cover, warm ink #34291F, chestnut #664831, burgundy #98493B accents. Pixel-cut edges. Most surfaces quiet and readable. This must feel like a premium pixel adventure game with beautiful information architecture. The journal metaphor creates clear structure, not decorative clutter. Use clear compact pixel display typography and clean highly legible body type, strong hierarchy, consistent alignment and controllable buttons. Pixel sprites small brown upright rabbit with pink inside ears and tiny square eyes, reference classic low-resolution rabbit game sprites. Pixel icons for carrots, padlocks, scroll, gear.
TOP SCREEN PROFILE:
LEFT PAGE player passport: 'Mon profil', LARGE pixel brown rabbit passport portrait in moss-green photo frame, name 'BitterEars99' immediately below, small 'Invité' ink stamp. A clearly labeled name-edit field and small pencil/save control. Bottom account block 'Sauvegarder mon terrier', one short explanatory line, 3 equal compact buttons 'Google', 'E-mail', 'Wallet'. At absolute bottom a quiet small separated text link 'Abandonner ce terrier'.
RIGHT PAGE collectible album: 'Choisir mon lapin', EIGHT large stamp-like collectible slots in a neat 4-column x 2-row grid. 5 available brown/gray/orange/white/pale-yellow rabbit sprites, three locked silhouettes. Brown selected with moss outline and tick. Slots have modest perforated edge motif. Tiny useful caption 'Sélectionne ton compagnon'. No invented game stats or levels.
BOTTOM SCREEN HISTORY, same open book and right-edge navigation, 'Historique' bookmark active:
LEFT PAGE 'Carottes récoltées', two large legible ledger rows with dates 'Aujourd’hui' 141, '2 octobre' 564. Orange bars encode actual counts: first bar one quarter the second, no written explanation of ratios. Lower part small pixel drawing of carrots stored in a basket, not huge scenery.
RIGHT PAGE headed 'Journal des raids': one actual tidy ledger/receipt row, crossed swords pixel icon, 'Raid sur LuckyCl…', green '+880' with carrot, 'Il y a 6 jours'. Lower right section 'Achats', small empty pixel crate, text 'Aucun achat pour le moment'. No invented transactions or achievements.
Screens should fit contents using purposeful comfortable type sizes. No random huge empty pages. Distinct strong book silhouette, binding in exact middle and bookmark navigation make this unmistakably different from a rectangular settings modal. Simple dusky forest backdrop surrounding the books, minimal outer clutter. French UI exact, no implementation notes, no watermarks.
